reader_summary.overview: Today, we are replaying what we call a forever episode. Every time I re-listen to this episode with David Senra, I leave wildly energized and wanting to share that feeling. So we are re-releasing it today for anyone who missed it the first time or hadn't yet discovered Invest Like the Best.

key_points.text: Today, we are replaying what we call a forever episode.
David Senra has studied history’s great founders and entrepreneurs in more depth than anyone I’ve ever met.
In this conversation, we cover many of the most common themes he’s discovered studying hundreds of entrepreneurs like Estée Lauder, John Rockefeller, Enzo Ferrari.
